title: Gorenstein Monomial Curves from Principal Matrices
supplement_frozen_submission_review_mark: The historical pending sentence is superseded by SUPPLEMENT_AUDIT.md.
retained_results: Identical singleton sets of genuine rank-three principal matrices for the two stated minimal primitive tuples, with types seven and one; the Gorenstein member is a complete intersection.
Saturated, column-balanced genuine five-cycle principal matrices have at least two distinct pseudo-Frobenius numbers.
quantifiers: Complete sets are equal singletons in Theorem 1. Existence of any genuine principal matrix satisfying Theorem 4 is sufficient for non-Gorensteinness; pattern invariance and necessity are not claimed.
gcd_convention: Collective gcd one, not pairwise coprimality.
CI_limitation: The Gorenstein member of the identical-data pair is a complete intersection; original non-CI focus remains unresolved.
